label: copy phase: fed-back c, mid/late in the copy, not the last output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (none in the original or delimiter phases), and almost entirely when the token fed back as input is the letter c (89% of activation mass; c shows 26x lift). It never fires on the first occurrence of a token. Activations are strongest when c is fed back at recall_idx 3-4 with at least one output still to come; the top examples are all c followed by l, v, s or x. Weak activations also occur on fed-back v, l, d and x. Precision is low: most copy-phase c inputs stay inactive, especially early ones (recall_idx < 3) and c as the final input. Requiring a next output in {l,v,x,d,s,i} raises precision to about 0.7 but halves recall, so what drives the magnitude is only partly captured. Dev: c-in-copy alone gives P 0.20 / R 0.80 / mass 0.89; the chosen predicate gives P 0.37 / R 0.68 / F1 0.48 / mass 0.80.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=13: c, v, l, d; t=12: c, v, l, d; t=11: c, v, l, d) and the token being output (most: l, v, x, d, s, i; least: 0, e, j, g); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=14.
